name: basedcode-ai
description: Connect Codex to a scoped BasedCode AI instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped BasedCode AI tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to BasedCode AI through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so BasedCode AI Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use BasedCode AI only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
